item.title: What my Second PhD Paper Taught Me
item.description: A personal reflection on an APSIPA paper, focusing on the pressures, constraints, and lessons that shaped the work beyond what appeared in the final publication.

item.title: The Hidden Struggles of My First Doctoral Paper
item.description: A reflective look back at my first published paper at ICASSP 2022. The post moves beyond technical results to discuss the realities of PhD life: GPU shortages, the shift from architecture design to empirical iteration, and the personal motivation behind researching audio tools as a hearing-impaired individual.
